classification.rationale: The product is a fine metal powder of tin alloyed with silver and copper, with no flux, so it is not a solder preparation of 3810. Heading 8007 covers tin powders and flakes (8007.00.32.00), and NY N357709 classified tin-lead solder powder there. However, chapter 71 note 5 treats an alloy as a silver alloy if silver is 2 percent or more by weight, and many SAC solders contain about 3 percent silver, which would move the powder to 7106.10; the silver percentage is not given, so the answer depends on that fact.
